_comment: DM identity denylist (kill-switch + admission block). identity_mappings was REMOVED: DM resolves the requester's POSIX identity by a READ-ONLY LDAP lookup at preflight time (no registration, no cached mapping table). The ONLY persisted DM identity state is this denylist, and it is normally EMPTY (default = allow all). Apply one entry with: PUT /api/v1/data-management/identity-denylist/{subject_type}/{subject} with body {"reason": "..."}; remove with DELETE on the same path. subject_type is one of requester|owner|group. 'requester' and 'owner' are matched BEFORE the LDAP lookup (instant block); 'group' is matched against the resolved LDAP groups AFTER the lookup.
